SUNIL KUMAR DAS Change & Transformation Leader | Financial Services & Capital Markets Mobile: 7395931496 Email: sunil.das95@gmail.com ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ━━━━━━━

Total Experience: 12+ Years Financial Services | Investment Banking | Capital Markets

▌ EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Change & Transformation professional with 12+ years of experience across Financial Services, Investment Banking, Capital Markets and Banking Operations, with experience leading business change, adoption and transformation across complex global environments. Experienced in change impact assessment, business and market readiness, readiness governance, entry/exit criteria, stakeholder and change-network management, training and communications, adoption measurement, go-live readiness and hypercare. Proven ability to establish central change frameworks, playbooks, templates and minimum standards while coordinating local business teams, SMEs and change champions to drive consistent execution across markets. Strong experience partnering with Business, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance and senior stakeholders to manage dependencies, RAID, risks, issues and readiness sign-offs. Deep domain experience across Investment Banking, Capital Markets, FX Operations, AML/KYC, financial operations and regulatory change.

▌ CORE EXECUTIVE COMPETENCIES

Change & Adoption Strategy Business & Market Readiness • Change Impact Assessment Readiness Frameworks & Entry/Exit Criteria • Central & Local Change Governance Change Champions & SME Networks • Training & Communications Adoption Measurement

Go-Live & Hypercare Readiness Operating Model & Process Transformation • RAID, Risk & Dependency Management Stakeholder & Executive Governance • Regulatory & Control Readiness Financial Services & Capital Markets • AML/KYC & Operational Controls Transformation Governance

▌ DOMAIN EXPERTISE

Investment Banking Operations | Capital Markets | FX Operations | Financial Services Transformation | Banking Operations | Collateral & Margin Operations | Mutual Fund Operations | AML/KYC | Operational Risk & Controls | Regulatory Compliance | Client Servicing

▌ PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Change Manager 2021 – Sep 2025 Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Financial Services Clients – Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley • Led end-to-end business change and adoption for complex financial services transformation programmes across global stakeholder groups

Feb

and business units.

Developed and executed Change & Adoption strategies covering change impact assessment, business readiness, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, adoption and post-go-live reinforcement.

Established business and market readiness frameworks, including readiness checkpoints, entry/exit criteria, required deliverables and business signoffs across key transformation milestones.

Conducted structured change impact assessments across people, processes, roles, controls and technology, translating impacts into actionable readiness and adoption plans.

Established central change governance and coordinated local business teams, SMEs and change champions to drive consistent execution while accommodating market-specific requirements.

Developed change playbooks, templates, guidance and minimum standards to provide a consistent approach to change delivery across teams and markets.

Coordinated training and communications, including stakeholder messaging, training materials, user enablement and reinforcement

activities; tracked completion and effectiveness.

Defined and monitored adoption and readiness measures, identifying gaps and driving corrective actions to support transition to BAU. • Led go-live readiness, coordinating Business, Operations, Technology, Risk and Compliance stakeholders and ensuring readiness actions and approvals are completed.

Supported hyper care governance and post-go-live feedback loops, capturing adoption issues and coordinating remediation with relevant teams.

Managed RAID, dependencies, risks, issues and escalations, providing options and impact assessments for executive decision-making. • Ensured transformation activities met AML/KYC, regulatory and control requirements and maintain appropriate governance evidence.

Sunil Kumar Das | Change & Transformation

Specialist 2018 – Feb 2021 State Street HCL Financial Services • Managed collateral and margin-call workflows across financial products, supporting counterparty-risk mitigation and operational control. • Led resolution of complex operational escalations and reviewed incoming margin calls to ensure timely and accurate processing. • Maintained SLA adherence and supported operational governance across financial-services processes. Process Associate 2017 – Mar 2018 Bank of New York Mellon • Processed daily mutual fund transactions, ensuring timely and accurate settlement. • Executed Cala stone fund transfer requests within the operational team. Assistant Manager 2012 – Dec 2016 HDFC Bank Ltd. • Executed branch-level banking operations maintaining adherence to bank policies and regulatory guidelines. • Provided operational support to Relationship Managers to ensure efficient client servicing and retention. MBA – Finance & Marketing | Biju Patnaik University of Technology (BPUT) | 2012 Bachelor of Economics (Honours) | B.J.B Autonomous College | 2009
